toolsPreview.name: fleet_overview
toolsPreview.description: Summary of every strategy sleeve: total and evaluation-window returns, drawdown, live days, and the 20 most recent submitted orders. All series are indexed to 100 at inception (paper capital is arbitrary; only performance is published). All figures are SIMULATED paper trading.

toolsPreview.name: sleeve_record
toolsPreview.description: Full public record for one sleeve: stats, indexed performance curve (100 = inception), drawdown series, and the complete submitted-order log. All figures are SIMULATED paper trading.

toolsPreview.name: gate_status
toolsPreview.description: The pre-registered go-live gate: criteria frozen on 2026-07-05, current progress, and the binding interpretation (this gate tests operational competence, not alpha).

toolsPreview.name: research_journal
toolsPreview.description: The live research journal: every internal research document (experiment pre-registrations, incident write-ups, verdicts including nulls), auto-published verbatim by the daily export. Returns the manifest; fetch a document with research_note.

toolsPreview.name: research_note
toolsPreview.description: Full markdown text of one published research document, by slug (see research_journal for the list). Verbatim internal writing; credential identifiers redacted.

toolsPreview.name: kill_list
toolsPreview.description: Every strategy idea this platform built, tested, and rejected — with dates, verdicts, and honest reasons. Publishing failures is the credibility mechanism.

toolsPreview.name: site_guide
toolsPreview.description: What Thales is, every machine-readable endpoint, and the verification standard the project holds itself to.
